snippet.title: NINJA Reveal Trailer || A Few Quick Matches
snippet.description:
in collaboration with YOUR ONLY MOVE IS HUSTLE, Ninja joins the cast as the 4th playable fighter!! A FEW QUICK MATCHES launches August 5th, with Ninja not far behind as FREE DLC later this August :))
